title: Machine Finishes
subtitle: A new look for old machines
text:
A Machine Finish Kit changes how a built machine looks without changing what it does. Use it on the machine. Ancient, Industrial and Clean finishes come with the mod. A plain kit takes the finish off again.

Resource packs add finishes with a json file in simplemachines/machine_finishes, naming a front, side, back and top texture. Give a kit for it with the simplemachines:machine_finish component.
